interpretation.sameSecondOrCappedUnchangedExpiry: Known successful renewal response with extension not demonstrated; the original revoke/403 chain still executes.

interpretation.increasedExpiry: True only when the independently observed post expiry is greater than the independently observed pre expiry for the same credential/accessor.
interpretation.completeFutureScope: After both independent inverse phases and original validation, both renewal expiry observations must have increased. exactSourceBasis.meaning: lookup-self resolves the authenticated principal and projects observed token data without mutation.
service token lookup exposes creation_time, ttl, expire_time_unix, renewable, namespace and accessor.

renewal checks actual AppRole provenance, active mount, role and renewable flag; updates expiry using the role's lifetime calculation; responds with accessor and lease duration.
expiry follows live TTL/max limits and original issue-time/explicit maximum. An unchanged expiry is not proof that the renew request failed.
